_about: 0.15 stage 1: the design system as DATA. Not read by the app yet. u = 1 px at Windows scale 100 % and Text size Normal; every size below is multiplied by (Windows scale x Text size factor 0.9 / 1 / 1.15 / 1.3).

caption.role: units, hints, tooltips, labels on the picture; the smallest text anywhere

body.role: every control label, readout line and paragraph

display.role: the one name of the screen (element, planet, nuclide)

min_px.rule: no interface text below 13 px at Normal; at Small (x0.9) the floor stays 12 px

primary.limit: one per group, at most one in view

rules: at most 2 surface levels inside one panel (panel, inset)
no outline around groups; groups are separated by 24 u of space
a 1 px divider (line colour) only between rows of one list
text-less controls (tick box, switch, slider track, text field) keep an edge computed to 3:1 against what is behind them
one shadow only, under floating things (popover, drawer, dialog)
